The PR claims the attempts are already bounded to three. That claim is false at the pre-rework head, so it is dropped until the repair lands.

Changing those two lines satisfies both the base rule and the ticket. No rewrite or replacement abstraction is required. The original commits and the existing retry loop are preserved.
